offers_products.reason: Makes SCBA respirators, gas detectors, fall protection, helmets and fixed gas and flame detection systems.

offers_services.reason: Services such as calibration and maintenance are incidental to the safety equipment it sells.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells safety equipment to firefighters' departments, industrial employers and distributors, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are fire departments, industrial companies, military and distributors purchasing safety gear for workers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat purchases of sensors, cartridges, replacement parts and regular equipment refresh by the same industrial and fire customers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Safety equipment is largely regulation-driven and mandated for fire departments and industrial workers, so demand holds up in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are detectors, helmets, harnesses and replacement parts, which are small and frequent, though SCBA fleet orders can be larger.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured safety products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mixed: many distributors, municipal fire departments and industrial firms of all sizes, with some government and large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufacturer of instruments and protective gear with moderate plant needs, not heavy manufacturing or networks.

notes: Large-customer answer is a judgment call, since sales go through distributors to buyers of mixed size.
